description: This file contains a configuration class for setting up OpenAPI metadata in a Spring Boot application. It defines a bean that provides API information such as title, description, version, contact information, and external documentation for API documentation purposes.

classes.name: OpenApiConfig
classes.description: Configuration class that sets up OpenAPI metadata for the application.

methods.name: customOpenAPI
methods.description: Creates and returns an OpenAPI object configured with API metadata such as title, description, version, contact, and external documentation.
